concept: 1978 VHS ritual in the language of The Holy Mountain: in a bone-white operating theatre built like a chapel, an old priest with his back to the camera raises his arms over a blob of raw pink flesh with dozens of thin pale fingers slowly curling, blood dripping down the white altar; a 117 in dripping blood on the bare wall
audio_source: original sound made locally: synthesized organ, bells and noise with Windows text-to-speech voices; no third-party audio
